items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: That's where we ran into I think Freddie Webster and Howard McGhee, who were there at that particular time. I remember them coming that night and sitting in with the band.

ctx.x: There's something else I wanted to mention about Charlie Parker....

Anyway, we finished that engagement, and went to Cleveland. From St. Louis to Cleveland, Ohio, I think -- yeah. That's where we ran into I think Freddie Webster and Howard McGhee, who were there at that particular time. I remember them coming that night and sitting in with the band. And the band was really beginning to get popping, beginning to be known through the grapevine around the country that Billy Eckstine had this band and it had all the "hip" cats in it, and everybody was playing this music that was the…

I'm trying to think... There was just so many funny things happened that I'm reminded of. I think it was in Cleveland, Ohio, where I got the first inkling of Charlie Parker, some of his erratic behavior. Because he had a room with someone in the band who came into Billy Eckstine's room one day... We were all sitting in Billy Eckstine's room. He came in, and he was mad as hell. Everybody wanted to know what was wrong, and he said that he and Bird were rooming together, and he woke up one morning, and Bird had been…
